text:
Maya: Quick check — planning to enable canary for model v12 tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Start at 5% (na, eu), ramp to 20% over 2h. Need guardrails and rollback criteria. @Ash can you be on-call? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: Ack — I can add telemetry hooks for per-route latency + 5xx, and a quality regression alert. Do we want error_rate or delta-quality? :thinking_face:
Jordan: Suggest preflight: small A/B with steady traffic for 30m, confirm KV-cache warms. Also ensure `max_tokens` cap is applied to reduce tail cost.
Kevin: PR opened for the toggle config: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4823 — includes rollout schedule and signals. Need one more review.
Maya: Guardrail proposal: auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 200ms for 15m, or quality drop > 5% over 30m. Thoughts?
Ash: I can be oncall 09:00–11:00 UTC. I'll add a PagerDuty rota and dashboard watch. Add alert thresholds to the runbook.
Sam: I'll wire up alerts. Also recommend a canary-only trace flag to capture inputs for debugging: `trace=canary_v12` (redacted storage).
Jordan: We should pin quantized variant in eu to avoid perf jitter: use `v12-q4_0` there; fallback to `v11` if not available.
Kevin: Noted. Will include per-region model pin in the flag payload.
Maya: Adding the rollout payload here (small JSON):
```json
{
  "flag": "model_v12_canary",
  "initial_pct": 5,
  "targets": ["na","eu"],
  "ramp": [{"after_mins":30,"pct":20}],
  "fallback": "v11",
  "auto_rollback": {"error_rate_pct":0.5,"p95_ms":200,"quality_drop_pct":5}
}
```
Sam: +1. I'll make sure the telemetry emits `canary.v12.latency.p95` and `canary.v12.error_rate`.
Kevin: Quick ops note: merge PR only after we confirm the CI perf test passes (integration/perf-canary). Pinged @Sam @Jordan for review.
Jordan: Reviewing now, small nit around the cache warm script.
Maya: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/team/rollouts/runbook-model-canary — please add any steps you want.
Ash: I'll watch the dashboard and have the rollback command ready. Rollback CLI snippet for oncall: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/flags/rollback -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PD' -d '{"flag":"model_v12_canary","to":0}'`
DeployBot: scheduled toggle set: 2025-03-12T09:00:00Z — `flags/model_v12_canary` -> 5% in [na, eu].
Sam: 09:05 seeing a small P50 bump in na, no error spike. Watching.
Jordan: Logs look clean, no 5xx from inference pods. KV-hit rates normal.
Maya: 09:35 check-in: all green so far, plan to trigger ramp to 20% at +30m if stable.
Kevin: Merging rollout doc to confluence and tagging this thread in the deployment notes.
Maya: Thanks all — will call out once we hit 20% and then follow for 2h. :rocket:
Ash: Ready to run rollback if alerts trip. Will @page if thresholds exceeded.
DeployBot: deployment started (2025-03-12T09:00:05Z) — canary at 5% set.
